legend: The Berland road network consists of n cities and of m bidirectional roads. The cities are numbered from 1 to n, where the main capital city has number n, and the culture capital — number 1. The road network is set up so that it is possible to reach any city from any other one by the roads. Moving on each road in any direction takes the same time.
All residents of Berland are very lazy people, and so when they want to get from city v to city u, they always choose one of the shortest paths (no matter which one).

The Berland government wants to make this country's road network safer. For that, it is going to put a police station in one city. The police station has a rather strange property: when a citizen of Berland is driving along the road with a police station at one end of it, the citizen drives more carefully, so all such roads are considered safe. The roads, both ends of which differ from the city with the police station, are dangerous.

Now the government wonders where to put the police station so that the average number of safe roads for all the shortest paths from the cultural capital to the main capital would take the maximum value.
input: The first input line contains two integers n and m (2 ≤ n ≤ 100, ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/830edae867a954b8b9fed8adb7a01c55020312a0.png)) — the number of cities and the number of roads in Berland, correspondingly. Next m lines contain pairs of integers vi, ui (1 ≤ vi, ui ≤ n, vi ≠ ui) — the numbers of cities that are connected by the i-th road. The numbers on a line are separated by a space.
It is guaranteed that each pair of cities is connected with no more than one road and that it is possible to get from any city to any other one along Berland roads.
output: Print the maximum possible value of the average number of safe roads among all shortest paths from the culture capital to the main one. The answer will be considered valid if its absolute or relative inaccuracy does not exceed 10 - 6.
note: In the first sample you can put a police station in one of the capitals, then each path will have exactly one safe road. If we place the station not in the capital, then the average number of safe roads will also make ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f23cc2cd3bef67bde56e16911c7af627da25d4d.png).

In the second sample we can obtain the maximum sought value if we put the station in city 4, then 6 paths will have 2 safe roads each, and one path will have 0 safe roads, so the answer will equal ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7723df54e28c93b1c3b9d4c68b039b5071092af.png).

legend.ai: Berland 的道路网络由 n 座城市和 m 条双向道路组成。城市编号从 1 到 n，其中主要首都的编号为 n，文化首都的编号为 1。该道路网络保证任意城市都可以通过道路到达其他任意城市。在每条道路上向任意方向行驶所需的时间都相同。
Berland 的所有居民都非常懒惰，因此当他们想要从城市 v 到达城市 u 时，总会选择一条最短路径（无论是哪一条）。
Berland 政府希望让这个国家的道路网络更加安全。为此，他们计划在某座城市中设置一个警察局。警察局具有一种相当奇特的性质：当 Berland 的居民沿着一端设有警察局的道路行驶时，他们会更加小心，因此所有这类道路都被视为安全道路。两端都不是设有警察局的城市的道路则是危险的。
现在，政府想知道应将警察局设在哪里，才能使从文化首都到主首都的所有最短路径中，安全道路数量的平均值达到最大。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m(2 ≤ n ≤ 100， ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/830edae867a954b8b9fed8adb7a01c55020312a0.png))——分别表示 Berland 中城市和道路的数量。接下来的 m 行包含两个整数 vi、ui(1 ≤ vi，ui ≤ n，vi ≠ ui)——表示由第 i 条道路连接的城市编号。每行中的数字以空格分隔。
保证任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路，并且沿着 Berland 的道路可以从任意城市到达任意其他城市。

output.ai: 输出从文化首都到主首都的所有最短路径中，安全道路数量平均值的最大可能值。当答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10 - 6 时，将被视为正确。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，可以将警察局设在其中一个首都，这样每条路径都恰好有一条安全道路。如果不将警察局设在首都，那么安全道路数量的平均值也会达到 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f23cc2cd3bef67bde56e16911c7af627da25d4d.png)。
在第二个样例中，如果将警察局设在城市 4，就可以得到所求的最大值。此时有 6 条路径各包含 2 条安全道路，另有 1 条路径包含 0 条安全道路，因此答案等于 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d7723df54e28c93b1c3b9d4c68b039b5071092af.png)。
